### Lietuvos valstybės istorijos archyvas

`repository` · [Website / directory](https://archyvai.lrv.lt/lt/struktura-ir-kontaktine-informacija/pavaldzios-istaigos/)

The Chief Archivist lists Lietuvos valstybės istorijos archyvas among Lithuania’s state archive institutions. This is a national specialist repository; its remit is not interchangeable with regional custody. For family history, compare historical locality and religious jurisdiction with fonds descriptions, and distinguish catalogue discovery from digitized images.
